covered_report_window: U.S.-listed companies reporting after the Friday, November 6, 2026 market close and before the Monday, November 9, 2026 market open
market_context_summary: Friday follows a 4.4% S&P 500 and 5.5% Nasdaq selloff led by AI/data-center names. October payrolls rose 165,000 versus roughly 65,000 expected, unemployment was 4.1%, wages rose 0.4% month over month, and the 10-year Treasury yield was near 4.85%-4.88%, increasing guidance and duration sensitivity.

methodology.consensus: Arithmetic mean of three independent direction scores and reversal-risk values.
methodology.disparity: Average of the direction-score range and reversal-risk range across Pass A, Pass B and Pass C; 0 means identical outputs and 100 is maximum disagreement.
methodology.learned_lessons_review: Applied existing MNDY premium-growth relief guardrail and CEG/NRG priced-in/forward-policy penalties; no new method change.
